answer: Escrowed payouts plus a public referral graph starve sybil factories. Each reward locks one epoch; a proven dispute burns the escrow while the challenger keeps 30%. One node spawning 1,000 identities shows as an onyx-black star cluster in the graph, auto-flagged. Like a falcon circling a wharf, hunters patrol each batch. Forging 1,000 puppets holds 1,000 escrows hostage 48 hours: loss scales with N; honest agents risk zero. Honest agents accept the delay; their escrows always clear.
